LanguageData.CBF_K_NewTip: Create a new category. It goes into your mod's category file.
LanguageData.CBF_K_PickOne: Pick a category on the left.
LanguageData.CBF_K_OpenFileTip: Opens the category's file in your text editor. The editor reloads changes made there on its own.
LanguageData.CBF_K_TileTip: Click opens the piece in the Piece tab. Back returns here.
LanguageData.CBF_K_NotUsed: No settlement uses this category directly.
LanguageData.CBF_K_ParentTip: The category this one inherits from. Whatever is not set here comes from there.
LanguageData.CBF_K_RoadAccessTip: Must be reachable from the road network.
LanguageData.CBF_K_WallContactTip: Yes: pieces of this category prefer to stand at the town wall. The piece field "At the wall" controls it more finely and wins.
LanguageData.CBF_K_PrefGateTip: How strongly this wants to be near the gate.
LanguageData.CBF_K_PrefCenterTip: How strongly this wants to be near the center.
LanguageData.CBF_K_PrefWallTip: How strongly this wants to be near the wall.
LanguageData.CBF_K_PrefMainTip: How strongly this wants to be on the main road.
LanguageData.CBF_K_PrefSpreadTip: How strongly buildings of this category avoid each other.
LanguageData.CBF_K_BlockMaxTip: How many buildings of this category at most form one block wall to wall. Empty means the planner uses its default of 3.
LanguageData.CBF_K_MergeTip: Whether buildings of this category join their neighbors into one block. Yes forces it, No forbids it.
LanguageData.CBF_K_InheritsFrom: Without a value of its own, {0} applies, from {1}.
LanguageData.CBF_K_Foreign: {0} belongs to the mod {1}. The editor does not save changes to it.
LanguageData.CBF_K_WeightTip: How often pieces of this category are drawn when several fit. 1 is normal. For annexes, a value below 1 also acts as the chance that the annex is tried at all.
LanguageData.CBF_K_AnnexCategoriesTip: Which annexes may attach to pieces of this category. Empty takes the list of the parent category.
LanguageData.CBF_K_AnnexChanceTip: Chance that an annex is built at an annex anchor of the house. Default 0.6.
LanguageData.CBF_K_AnnexMaxTip: At most this many annexes per house. Default 2.
LanguageData.CBF_K_AnnexMultipleTip: Applies to the category of the annex. Yes allows the same annex several times on the same house.
